views.name: movie_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  title,
  year,
  CAST(rating AS REAL) AS rating,
  CAST(num_votes AS INTEGER) AS num_votes
FROM Movie
views.description: Canonical projection of the Movie table with cleaned numeric casts for measures. Use this as the normalized movie-level base for joins and aggregations. | Use for: Top/bottom movies by rating or votes; Trends by year; Filtering movies for downstream joins (e.g., only movies with non-null rating)

views.name: genre_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  GID,
  Name
FROM Genre
views.description: Clean projection of Genre dimension. Use when you need genre Name associated with GID. | Use for: List genres, count movies per genre (when joined with M_Genre); Filter movies by genre name

views.name: language_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  LAID,
  Name
FROM Language
views.description: Clean projection of Language dimension. Use to map LAID to language Name. | Use for: Filter or aggregate movies by language; Join to M_Language to get per-movie languages

views.name: country_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  CID,
  Name
FROM Country
views.description: Clean projection of Country dimension. Maps CID to Name for joins. | Use for: Country-level counts of movies; Filter movies by production country

views.name: location_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  LID,
  Name
FROM Location
views.description: Clean projection of Location dimension. Use to map LID to place Name. | Use for: Identify movies filmed in a location; Aggregate number of movies per location

views.name: person_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PID,
  Name,
  Gender
FROM Person
views.description: Canonical projection of Person with core attributes preserved for joins to cast/crew bridges. | Use for: Look up person names/gender for cast/crew lists; Aggregate counts of movies per person (when joined with bridges)

views.name: m_genre_bridge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  GID,
  ID
FROM M_Genre
views.description: Canonical projection of the M_Genre bridge: one row per (movie, genre) association. Use to join movies to genres. | Use for: Count movies per genre; Join to Genre to produce movie-genre denormalized lists

views.name: m_language_bridge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  LAID,
  ID
FROM M_Language
views.description: Canonical projection of the M_Language bridge: one row per (movie, language) association. | Use for: List languages for a movie; Aggregate movies by language

views.name: m_country_bridge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  CID,
  ID
FROM M_Country
views.description: Canonical projection of the M_Country bridge: one row per (movie, country) association. | Use for: Aggregate movies by country; Filter movies produced in particular countries

views.name: m_location_bridge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  LID,
  ID
FROM M_Location
views.description: Canonical projection of the M_Location bridge: one row per (movie, location) association. | Use for: Find movies shot at a location; Aggregate filming locations per movie

views.name: m_cast_bridge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  PID,
  ID
FROM M_Cast
views.description: Canonical projection of the M_Cast bridge: one row per (movie, cast member) association. Use to join cast members to movies. | Use for: List cast for a movie; Count movies per actor

views.name: movie_genre_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  m.rating,
  m.num_votes,
  mg.GID,
  g.Name AS Name
FROM Movie AS m
JOIN M_Genre AS mg ON m.MID = mg.MID
LEFT JOIN Genre AS g ON mg.GID = g.GID
views.description: Denormalized relation of movies to their genres (one row per movie-genre). Includes movie metrics for easy aggregation by genre. | Use for: Movie counts and average ratings per genre; List movies for a given genre

views.name: movie_language_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  m.rating,
  m.num_votes,
  ml.LAID,
  l.Name AS Name
FROM Movie AS m
JOIN M_Language AS ml ON m.MID = ml.MID
LEFT JOIN Language AS l ON ml.LAID = l.LAID
views.description: Denormalized relation of movies to their languages (one row per movie-language). Useful for language-based aggregations. | Use for: Aggregate movies by language; Filter movies available in a specific language

views.name: movie_country_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  m.rating,
  m.num_votes,
  mc.CID,
  c.Name AS Name
FROM Movie AS m
JOIN M_Country AS mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
LEFT JOIN Country AS c ON mc.CID = c.CID
views.description: Denormalized relation of movies to their production countries (one row per movie-country). | Use for: Movies by production country; Country-level aggregates of movie ratings

views.name: movie_cast_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  mc.PID,
  p.Name AS Name,
  p.Gender AS Gender
FROM Movie AS m
JOIN M_Cast AS mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
LEFT JOIN Person AS p ON mc.PID = p.PID
views.description: Denormalized relation mapping movies to cast members, with person attributes. One row per movie-cast member. | Use for: List cast for specific movies; Compute number of distinct actors per movie or actor filmographies

views.name: movies_per_genre_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mg.GID,
  g.Name AS Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mg.MID) AS movie_count,
  AVG(m.rating) AS avg_rating,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.num_votes,0)) AS total_num_votes
FROM M_Genre AS mg
LEFT JOIN Movie AS m ON mg.MID = m.MID
LEFT JOIN Genre AS g ON mg.GID = g.GID
GROUP BY mg.GID, g.Name
views.description: Aggregate measures at the genre level: movie count, average rating, median-like approximation using AVG and counts not true median. One row per GID. | Use for: Rank genres by average rating or count; Genre-level reporting dashboards

views.name: actor_film_count
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mc.PID,
  p.Name AS Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) AS movies_count
FROM M_Cast AS mc
LEFT JOIN Person AS p ON mc.PID = p.PID
GROUP BY mc.PID, p.Name
views.description: Counts distinct movies per actor (person PID) based on the cast bridge. Useful for identifying prolific actors. | Use for: Find top actors by number of credits; Filter actors by minimum number of movies

views.name: movie_rating_rank_per_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  m.rating,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.year ORDER BY m.rating DESC) AS rating_rank_within_year
FROM Movie AS m
views.description: Assigns a dense rank of movies by rating within each year. One row per movie-year; use to get top movies per year. Ties receive same rank. | Use for: Retrieve top-N movies per year; Compare movie ranks across years

views.name: latest_movie_per_title
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  title,
  year,
  rating,
  num_votes
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY title ORDER BY CAST(year AS INTEGER) DESC, MID) AS rn
  FROM Movie AS m
) WHERE rn = 1
views.description: For titles that may have multiple entries (same title different years), pick the latest-year row. One row per title representing the latest movie. | Use for: De-duplicate by title picking the most recent release; Canonicalize title-level analyses

views.name: movies_with_primary_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  title,
  year,
  rating,
  num_votes
FROM Movie
WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
  AND num_votes IS NOT NULL
views.description: Subset of movies that have non-null rating and at least one vote. Useful as a cleaned cohort when analyses require valid ratings. | Use for: Compute averages/aggregates only over movies with valid ratings; Filter out incomplete records before ranking

views.name: movie_cast_count
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mc.MID,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mc.PID) AS cast_count
FROM M_Cast AS mc
GROUP BY mc.MID
views.description: Count of cast members per movie. One row per MID with cast_count measure. | Use for: Find movies with large or small casts; Correlate cast size with ratings

views.name: movies_with_cast_and_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  m.rating,
  m.num_votes,
  COALESCE(castc.cast_count,0) AS cast_count,
  COALESCE(prodc.prod_count,0) AS producer_count
FROM Movie AS m
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MID, COUNT(DISTINCT PID) AS cast_count FROM M_Cast GROUP BY MID
) AS castc ON m.MID = castc.MID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MID, COUNT(DISTINCT PID) AS prod_count FROM M_Producer GROUP BY MID
) AS prodc ON m.MID = prodc.MID
views.description: Movie-level relation augmented with cast_count and producer_count to support movie-level analyses without exploding to per-person rows. One row per MID. | Use for: Modeling or correlation tasks using movie attributes plus counts of credits; Filter movies by having at least one producer or cast member

views.name: genre_movie_matrix
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN g.Name = g1.Name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [genre_flag]
FROM Movie AS m
LEFT JOIN M_Genre AS mg ON m.MID = mg.MID
LEFT JOIN Genre AS g ON mg.GID = g.GID
LEFT JOIN Genre AS g1 ON 1=1
GROUP BY m.MID, m.title, m.year
views.description: Wide reshape: for each movie, emit a row with a genre flag per genre Name. Useful for quick filtering by genre via boolean columns. Note: sparse when many genres exist. | Use for: Quick boolean filtering by a genre (requires editing to reference specific genre names); Feature engineering for machine learning (one-hot-ish encoding)
